events.info: You ever seen a screening of the greatest comedy to ever hit the skies? Well surely youve seen Airplane! but not like this! events.name: Jimkata w/ The New Service
events.info: Jimkata returns to Middle Ages Music Hall with special guest The New Service!This show is part of Jimkatas 10-year celebration of their album In Motion. Blurring the line between a rock band and an electronic act, Jimkata delivers a high-energy live experience filled with soaring guitar riffs, infectious grooves and soul-stirring lyrics. With songs from throughout their extensive catalog on the table, every performance becomes an emotional and unpredictable ride.Built around the lifelong friendship of Evan Friedell, Aaron Gorsch and Packy Lunn, Jimkata combines adventurous musicianship with relatable storytelling and hard-driving indie rock. The addition of Cooper Casterline on bass has allowed the band to stretch its music even further onstage, blending modern electronic sounds with influences ranging from Motown and singer-songwriters to classic country.Syracuse-based rock fusion band The New Service will open the show. Formerly known as Pop Culture, the four-piece is known for its funky original music, hard-hitting jams and adventurous blend of thoughtful compositions, improvisation and impressive musicianship.PRESENTED BY VISIONS FCU
